title: Daily Betrayal By My Limbs

slides.text: She stays mad from very close range.

caption_draft: Some couples fight over big things. We mostly fight over my elbows, my feet, and my complete inability to turn around like a normal person. Tag the person whose love language is saying sorry immediately.
notes: Keep the joke on Zuv's harmless lack of spatial awareness, not on Aachu being hurt.
Aachu's anger should read theatrical and affectionate.
Zuv must stay active: apologizing, checking, softening, staying close.
